text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis (Cradle Cap) with potential psoriasiform changes.

The history of red, scaly rash worsening in cold weather in a 3-month-old, despite a family history of psoriasis, strongly points to seborrheic dermatitis. To rule out psoriasis or secondary infection, I am requesting images of the scalp and forehead rash for closer examination. REQUEST IMAGES
